name: Smart Merge AI
scope: Selected survivor admission, destination selection, pending chase/timeout, join and cleanup bodies with registration/preInit context; not full source or helper-descendant coverage. Installed mod.cpp identity/description also inspected.

dispositions.intent: Recover genuine casualty survivors rather than merge deliberate solo teams.
dispositions.source: Source checks peak combat history/other living members, isolation dwell/cooldown and optional explicit authorization. Pending destination suitability is rechecked on later callbacks.
dispositions.cbe: Existing casualty-only enqueue, peak-size threshold, remnant threshold and medical/task/mission protections retained. New job captures casualty-time living roster; later living additions or current size beyond remnant limit retire it. Direct jobs capture their initial roster once. Further losses may shrink scope.
dispositions.decision: Adapt continuous suitability and task membership scope into existing CBE owner, not source survivor polling/registries.

dispositions.intent: Approach a useful host which can absorb survivors without stealing specialised ownership.
dispositions.source: Target admission checks same-side or optional mutual alliance, optional faction, living/combat capacity, protection flags, reserved slots and range. Source scores distance plus faction/same-owner preferences.
dispositions.cbe: Current same-side/same-owner host selection, configured size/capacity and physical join distance retained. MOVE now rechecks host combat strength, side and own-regroup status; losing fitness returns to EVALUATE under original deadline. No automatic cross-side/faction integration added.
dispositions.decision: Implement the confirmed stale-host gap; reservation-provider helpers, faction/role policies and wider selection descendants remain to reconcile.

dispositions.intent: Finite approach and late cancellation should preserve newer task authority.
dispositions.source: updatePending reissues unit doMove on a cadence and may join at detection radius after timeout/stall; abortPending accepts an ownedMove boolean and current MOVE/empty command, then issues move-to-self/follow without exact destination/order proof. mergeUnit fires arbitrary veto/beforeMerge callbacks before membership mutation without a final post-callback full context check.
dispositions.cbe: Keep original CBE deadline, one retry, native/authored replacement guards, local membership and exact owned-MOVE cleanup. Do not import unowned repeated move/stop/follow, widened failure-time join authority or source hooks as command permission.
dispositions.decision: Reject unsafe mechanisms while retaining physical join/repeat/ownership verification as open requirements.

runtimeChanges.cost: One original survivor array retained in existing job; each callback compares current living members against it. MOVE counts combat-effective members of the already selected host, reusing its roster for live capacity. No new worker, world scan, geometry, setting or deadline; native roster/eligibility cost unmeasured.
remaining: Full Smart Merge startup/tick/settings/pressure tracking, reservation/veto helper and lifecycle descendants remain unreviewed; this is not whole-mod source parity.
Original CBE group-wide movement/formation/physical joining, reinforcement/host casualties/reselection/repeat/locality and performance require engine verification.

Generic regroup into specialised host task roles, source faction/allied policies and pressure-driven standalone isolation are separate intent decisions; no permission or implementation credit inferred from inventory.

verification.sourceNote: Unsigned dirty development candidate from base088dde17 plus this regroup patch; engineering notes postdate packaging.
